ORN Family · homeworkers

Launching ORN Family — we change the game.

A commission-only homeworker network that out-rewards every rival: 70% of margin to the agent, and we pay 50% at the time of booking — not months later. Everyone is part of our journey.

💸

50% paid at booking

Most homeworker models pay only after travel. We pay half the commission the moment the booking is made — unbeatable cashflow for the agent.

🤝

70 / 30 margin split

The agent keeps 70% of the booking margin; ORN takes 30%. Among the most generous splits in UK travel — and it still works for us at scale.

🛡️

We always win

We hold the 50% balance until after travel, release payout only once a monthly margin target is met, and claw commission back on cancellation — so risk stays protected.

How the ORN Family model works

A model built so everybody wins.

🔁 Rolling bookings protect us

Commission pays out only after an agent clears a monthly margin target, and we always hold the post-travel balance. With rolling monthly bookings, there's always a balance in hand — so cancellations are covered and ORN is never exposed.

↩️ Clawback on cancellation

If a customer cancels, commission already advanced is deducted from the agent's next payout. The held balance means we can always recover it — no bad debt.

❤️ Agents keep customers & keep selling

Because payout rewards sustained selling (monthly target) and retention (post-travel balance), agents are driven to keep customers and keep booking — exactly the behaviour that grows ORN.

🎓 Quality bar — min 2 years ABTA

ORN Family agents need a minimum of 2 years' ABTA experience, so customers get experienced advisors and ORN protects its licensed, bonded standard.

🤝 The Membership / Travel Club unlock

We hold partnership arrangements with ~20 sports organisations. Many more said no — not on interest, but because their fee was too high versus the group travel it would bring.

The Membership / Travel Club changes that conversation. Instead of a fee for group travel alone, we offer their members a travel club with credits and rewards — so we can re-approach every organisation we couldn't previously sign.

How 6 million reach becomes £9m of member sales

Only a fraction of a fraction needs to convert. At a conservative ~0.09% of the reachable audience booking, the member channel delivers its £9m — with Swim England, the new deal and the Travel Club all adding headroom above this.

Why we must be licensed

Not just a DMC — a licensed UK entity.

To sell flights and packages to UK consumers is a regulated activity. UK passengers want full travel, so ORN Europe must be a licensed, bonded UK company in its own right — this is what unlocks the full £30m, and the untapped UK market too.

ATOL (CAA)

Legally required to sell flight-inclusive packages to UK consumers — financial protection and the ATOL certificate every customer receives.

ABTA

ABTA membership & bonding

Trust mark and consumer protection for non-flight travel; bonding covers customer monies. Expected by consumers and trade partners alike.

🏛️

UK legal entity, staff & paying agents

A UK company with named accountable directors, UK-employed team, protected trust/client money, and paying-agent/treasury to settle suppliers across Europe.

🇬🇧

Unlocks the UK market too

The same licence lets us sell tours within the UK — a huge market we haven't started, including a UK "be with the stars" Bollywood tour.
